q: Can a CBAM verifier tell us how to fix our monitoring?
title: Can a CBAM verifier advise you
short: No. A verifier can point out misstatements and non-conformities and recommend improvements, but must not tell you in detail how to make them. Consulting would compromise its impartiality and could cost it its accreditation. Use a separate adviser for fixes.
audience: Indian operators working through findings from a CBAM verification

ul: Ask you to correct misstatements before issuing the report.
Check your monitoring plan against the rules.
Write or redesign your monitoring plan.

senseible: Senseible keeps the invoices behind each fuel and electricity figure in one fingerprinted record, so a verifier can sample them without a hunt through files. Senseible is not a CBAM verifier and does not issue verification reports.
